name: Herten (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically green and white below a white banner head bearing the city arms of Herten (a white bar on green above a chequy base).
history: Municipal flag of Herten; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Herten arms — bar on green above chequy
